published_baseline: Founder-approved website baseline after Ask Geomacro conversational redesign. /ask-geomacro uses a compact chatbot-style conversation surface: user question bubble, one question-specific direct answer, compact optional evidence, persistent visible turns, Enter-to-send and Shift+Enter newline. The richer structured Ask fields remain internal/public-contract compatible but are not repeated as fixed report sections in the UI. Ask continues to use verified B2/live intelligence, fail-closed evidence rules, rate limits, injection rejection and the existing user-facing data boundary; raw source content, provider details and internal retrieval payloads remain hidden. /global-risk remains independently hard-pinned by config/global-risk-final-lock.json and its dedicated fail-closed verifier.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update. The finalized /global-risk presentation is additionally protected by its independent permanent lock.
